title: Regex Subset Matcher (. and *)

hidden.label: Empty text vs optional star pairs
Empty text vs literal required char

hints: When pattern[j + 1] == "*", you have two choices: skip 0 copies (`dfs(i, j + 2)`), OR if current chars match, consume one text char and stay at pattern index j (`dfs(i + 1, j)`).
Memoize `(i, j)` states using `@functools.lru_cache(None)` or a 2D DP table so repeated branches like `"a*a*a*a*...c"` run in O(len(text) * len(pattern))!
